contexts.text: To eat bread in the sweat of the countenance () = to feel aversion for what is celestial. Bread = everything spiritual and celestial which is angelic food... What is celestial and spiritual in Heaven corresponds to bread on earth, and these things are also represented by bread. Illustrated. AC 2342.
Bread of the increase of the ground () = charity. ( = what is celestial. AC 415:2.)
The bread which they shall eat with disquietude () = celestial things... to which they have offered violence, or which they have profaned. AC 6297:2.
Under Food, see this reference.
To break the staff of bread () = to be deprived of celestial sustenance. AC 2576:11. AC 3104:2. AC 7102:5. AE 386:9.
They who have studied eloquence for the sake of self admiration have a sphere which smells of burnt bread. SE 1046.
(Melchizedek) brought forth bread () = celestial things and refreshment therefrom.
The bread and wine (in the Holy Supper) = the Lord's love towards the universal human race.
A famine in the city, and no bread for the people of the land () = that there was nothing of faith and nothing of charity left.
I will take a piece of bread () = something celestial adjoined... As bread, in general, means all food, so in the inward sense it = all celestial food. Illustrated.
The burnt-offerings and sacrifices... were all called in one word the bread of what is fiery to Jehovah. Illustrated.

When sacrifices were abolished, and other things for outward worship succeeded in their place, it was commanded that bread and wine should be employed... Bread therefore = all those things which the sacrifices represented, thus in the inward sense, the Lord Himself, and because the Lord Himself, His love towards universal mankind, and what is of His love; also the reciprocal [love] of man to the Lord and towards the neighbour; thus it = all celestial things, and wine, all spiritual things. Illustrated. AC 2177. AC 2177:8. AC 2187.

As bread = the Lord, it = the celestial things which are of love, and are of the Lord; for the Lord is the Celestial itself, because He is love itself, that is, mercy itself; and because this is the case, bread also = everything celestial, that is, all love and charity with man, for they are from the Lord; wherefore they who are not in love and charity have not the Lord with them, thus are not endowed with the goods and happinesses which are signified by bread in the inward sense.

The breads called the bread of faces, or the show bread, was made of fine flour, prepared in cakes and set on the table in continual representation of the Lord's love, that is mercy, towards the universal human race, and the reciprocal love of man. Illustrated.
That they felt aversion for the goods of charity is signified by satiety of bread ().
Celestial and spiritual things free from impurities were represented by unleavened bread.
Under Body, see these references. AC 10521.
(Abraham) took bread and a bottle of water () = good and truth. AC 2928:2.
When bread is read of in the Word, the Angels do not perceive bread, but celestial love.

Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles () = the good of life endowed with the good of truth and the good of doctrinal things... Bread = the good of love in general, both celestial and spiritual, thus also the good of truth, for this is spiritual good.
His body, and the bread = love to the Lord.

The bread (of faces) on the table seen represented there... and they perceived it to signify the sustenance on which the Angels live, thus celestial and spiritual love with their joyousnesses and happinesses; and in both the former and the latter the Lord Himself, as the Bread or Manna from Heaven, besides many things in the form, position and number of the breads.
Bread () = good. References. AC 3703:14. AC 4017:end.
When corn and must are predicated of natural good and truth, bread and wine are predicated of the Rational, bread signifying celestial good. References.
In the rituals of the Ancient Church... bread signified the things which are of love to the Lord.

If He will give me bread to eat () = even to conjunction with Divine good. Bread = all the celestial and spiritual good which is from the Lord, and in the highest sense, the Lord Himself as to Divine good. AC 3735:2. AC 3813:2.
(Jesus known in the breaking of bread, ) = that the Lord appears through good, but not through truth without good.

(Jacob) called his brethren to eat bread () = the appropriation of good from the Lord's Divine Natural... Bread = the good of love, and in the highest sense, the Lord. References. As bread in the highest sense = the Lord, it therefore = everything holy which is from Him, that is, everything good and true, and since there is no good which is good but that which is of love and charity, bread = love and charity; in ancient times the sacrifices had no other signification, wherefore they were called in one word bread. NJHD 221:2, Illustrated.
Bread (in the Holy Supper) = celestial love. AC 6377:2.

When bread is mentioned in the Word, the Angels do not know what material bread is, but what spiritual bread is; thus instead of bread they perceive the Lord, Who is the Bread of life, and as they perceive the Lord, they perceive those things which are from the Lord, thus His love towards the universal human race, and then at the same time they perceive the reciprocal [love] of man to the Lord, for these cohere in one idea of thought and affection. In a similar way does man think... when he takes the bread of the Holy Supper, for he does not then think of bread, but of the Lord and His mercy, and of those things which are of love to Him and of charity towards the neighbour... Hence it is evident that bread in the Word does not present with the Angels any idea of bread, but the idea of love, with innumerable things which are of love. AC 4700:2. AC 4976:2. AC 6789:2.
The meat-offering and drink-offering = the same as the bread and wine in the Holy Supper.
Bread, which (in the meat-offering) is fine flour mingled with oil; and wine = love and faith, thus the whole of worship, in the Holy Supper. References.
Bread = the good of love, or what is celestial. References. AC 4844:11. AC 5893. AC 5915. AC 9295:2. AE 175:8. AE 480. AE 617:10.
Divine celestial love is signified by the flesh or bread in the Holy Supper. Illustrated.
They sat down to eat bread () = the appropriation of evil from falsity. Explained.
The staff of bread = support and power from the good of love. AC 9028:end. AC 9323:2.
He knew not anything with him except the bread which he did eat () = that good was thence appropriated.
Bread corresponds to celestial love.
In all the land of Egypt there was bread () = remains from the multiplied truths from good. Explained.
The people cried to Pharaoh for bread () = the need of good for truth. Explained.

In the Ancient Church bread was broken when it was given to another, and by this was signified to communicate from one's own, and to appropriate what is good from one's own, and so effect mutual love. Explained, Illustrated. AE 617:21.
They heard that they should eat bread there () = the perception that good would be adjoined to truths... Bread = the good of love. References.
He said, Set on bread () = the perception of conjunction through the medium with truths in the Natural. Explained.

The Egyptians cannot eat bread with the Hebrews () = that they could not be at all [conjoined] with the truth and good of the Church... To eat bread = to be conjoined... It is said to eat bread, and above set on bread, because by bread is meant all food in general, thus eating; the reason bread means all food and also eating itself, is that in the spiritual sense bread = celestial love, and celestial love contains in itself all things which are of good and truth, thus all things which are of spiritual food. References.
Under Donkey, see this reference.
To support with bread () = the influx of good.
No bread in all the land () = that good no longer appeared.

Give us bread () = [supplication] concerning the support of spiritual life... Specifically, bread = the good of love and of charity, but in general, it = spiritual life, for in this case by bread is meant all food... AC 6124.
He provided them with bread for their cattle () = support through the influx of good from the Internal.
He said of the bread This is my body, because by bread also is signified Divine love. References.

Buy us and our ground for bread () = the appropriation of both, that they may be supported with good... The reason bread = the good of both love and faith, is that by it all food in general is also meant.
His bread fat () = delight from good.
Let him eat bread () = confirmation in good.
Under Oven, see this reference.
The bread baked for sacrifices, and called a meat-offering...
This good is the good of the exterior Natural and is signified by barley bread ().
Under Flour, see this reference, and at AC 7966.
They are forbidden to eat anything but bread.
Unleavened bread = good (of innocence).

Bread of cakes is thus distinguished from common bread; bread of cakes = the good of love towards the neighbour, thus spiritual good, and common bread = the good of love to the Lord, thus celestial good. The former spiritual good is signified by the meat-offering... The twelve show breads had a similar signification... But by these breads was signified the good of celestial love, and by their being cooked in cakes were signified the goods of spiritual love.
The want of bread and flesh concerning which the Sons of Israel murmured = the want of good. AC 9052:2.

When we did eat bread to the full () = that thus they enjoyed the good of pleasures as much as they wanted... Bread = the good of celestial life, and in the opposite sense, the good of natural life separated from celestial, thus the good of pleasures; for by bread in the spiritual sense is meant the primary thing which nourishes the soul, and preserves its spiritual life, and that this is the good of love is evident from the life of Heaven, which consists of this good alone: but in the opposite sense is meant the primary thing which nourishes those who are in Hell and supports their life; and that this is the evil of the love of self and of the world is evident from the life of Hell, which consists in this alone; this evil is good to them... and this is here meant by the good of pleasures.
Behold I am causing it to rain for you bread from Heaven () = that celestial good will flow in.

In the morning bread to the full () = that in the beginning of a new state they will have as much good as they can receive... Bread, here = the good of truth, which is the good of the spiritual Church, because by bread is meant the manna. AC 8527.

This is the bread which Jehovah hath given you to eat () = that this is the good which will be appropriated and will constitute their life; in the supreme sense, that this is the Lord in you. Bread = celestial and spiritual good, and in the supreme sense, the Lord (References), here, spiritual good, that is, the good of the man of the spiritual Church, which is the good of truth.
This is meant by the daily bread.
On the sixth day the bread of two days () = at the end of the former state as much of good through truth as that conjunction may then take place.

To eat bread with the father-in-law of Moses before God () = their appropriation from Divine good... Bread here means all the food which was used on the occasion, especially the flesh of the sacrifices... That bread = all worship in general. References.
Bread = the support of spiritual life by means of good. References.
Bread has exactly the same signification as flesh.
The leavened bread which was then offered () = good not as yet fully purified.
Under Bless, see this reference.

As bread = all the good of love, and water all truth of faith in the complex... it was a common formula to speak of bread and water when all natural food and drink were referred to, and all spiritual good and truth were meant. Illustrated. AE 71. AE 304:14. AE 433:33. AE 701:12.
Flesh and the bread = the Divine good of the Lord's Divine love towards the universal human race, and the reciprocal [love] of man to the Lord. AC 10040:2.
To break the bread and give to them () in the Spiritual World = to instruct in the good and truth of faith, through which the Lord appears.
The breads of faces upon the table, and the candlestick, represented the celestial things which are from the Lord in the Heavens.
The inmost things of the Celestial Kingdom or Church were signified by those things which were upon the table, chiefly by the breads.
Bread and waters () = the internal goods of love and truths of faith; wool and flax = the same, but external.
The breads of faces = the celestial good which is from the Lord. AE 324:25. AE 491:4.
Thou shalt set upon the table the bread of faces () = the Lord there as to celestial good.
(The spiritual reason why the Roman Catholics give the bread alone to the people.) AE 1054:end.
One loaf of bread () = inmost celestial good from the Lord. AC 10079.
And one cake of bread of oil () = middle celestial good.

The reason why not only the fat of the ram and the right flank were burned on the altar, but also the breads which were called meat-offerings, when yet (they both) equally = good... was that sacrifices and burnt-offerings were not commanded, but permitted... therefore meat-offerings, which were breads, were also employed...
(To eat) the bread which is in the basket () = the appropriation of celestial good from the Lord.
Under Flesh, see this reference.
Bread (in the Holy Supper) = the Lord as to the good of love.
The breads of faces represented love to the Lord.
Bread he did not eat, and water he did not drink () = meanwhile no appropriation of the good of love and of the truth of faith.
Bread (in the fifth Earth), Described.

Bread (from grain) in general corresponds to the affection of all good, because it supports life more than all other things, and because all food is meant by it. On account of this correspondence the Lord is called the bread of life; and for the same reason breads were in use in the Israelitish Church... called the breads of faces; and also all the Divine worship which was effected by means of sacrifices and burnt-offerings was called bread...
(References to passages on the subject of bread.)
That when the ancients mentioned bread they meant all food in general, Illustrated.

Bread = all good which proceeds from the Lord, for the Lord Himself is in His own good; thus the bread and wine in the Holy Supper = all worship of the Lord from the good of love and of faith. Illustrated.
Flesh or the bread = the good of love from the Word.
The prince invited them to eat bread with him. CL 14:2, Described. CL 14:20, Described.
The bread (in the Holy Supper) in Heaven = Divine good. TCR 372.
It is like giving bread to a devil...
The conjunction itself was represented by the breaking and distribution of the bread...
By the Lord's flesh and the bread is meant the Divine good of His love, and also all the good of charity. General article. AE 329:2.
One evening I took much bread and milk...

On broken bread. There was offered me in a vision a small plate of bread cut into squares, which I imagined to signify that which is the communication of bread, namely, celestial things, and I rejoiced. It was placed to my mouth that I might eat... but was not eaten so long as I was of opinion that that bread signified celestial things. I was told that broken bread, not cut, signified celestial things; for bread is broken with the lips and teeth, as at first with the hand, before it is eaten; which being according to nature, celestial things are signified by bread broken with the hands, lips, and teeth, and so on into the most minute particles by the muscles, fibres, and as it were most minute hands, lips, and mouths of the recipient vessels.

But bread cut with a knife is what counterfeits what is celestial... as is the case with everything done artificially; wherefore the bread set before me, being cut into little squares and cubes as it were with knives, signified filthy delights, which are supposed by those who are in them to be celestial, when yet they are infernal.
To eat of this bread = to be conjoined to Him through love.
To give bread to the hungry () = from the good of charity to instruct those who long for truths.
To break bread for the hungry () = from love to do good to the neighbour who longs for good.
The bread and wine (in the Holy Supper) = all spiritual food and drink...
The bread and wine = goods and truths in the spiritual man.
The bread of God, and the bread of life is that from which there is life for all. AE 899:6, Explained.
The bread (in the Holy Supper) = the good of love from the Lord to the Lord.
Bread involves everything of Heaven and the Church, or all spiritual nourishment.
Bread = the good from which is spiritual life.
To give bread to the hungry () = to nourish, and spiritual nourishment is knowledge, intelligence, and wisdom.
Bread in general = all spiritual food. AE 537:13. AE 555:3. AE 555:12. AE 706:10.
It shall eat up thy harvest and thy bread () = that it will destroy all truths and goods through which there is spiritual nourishment. AE 911:14.
The breads (of faces) = the Divine good of the Divine love.
The loaves = the goods, and the fishes the truths of the natural man.
Bread () = the Lord, and the good of love from Him.
The bread of straitness () = temptations as to the good of love.
Bread () = the Word, from which there is spiritual nourishment.
Divine good proceeding is signified by flesh and the bread.
The good of love and of charity is signified by bread to the eater ().
Bread () = the good of love and of charity, which is nourished by means of truths.
To break the staff of bread () = to deprive of spiritual food, and thence of spiritual nutrition; for bread = all that which nourishes the soul, specifically the good of love. AE 727:12. AE 727:13.
To get bread with peril of souls () = the difficulty and danger of procuring for themselves the truths of life from the Word.
Bread of increase () = the fructification of good.
